newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks bounce higher in early morning trade.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks bounce higher in early morning trade.

text.p: Tokyo stocks bounced higher in early morning trade on Friday as Nikkei 225 September futures and options were being settled, brokers said.
They said buy positions were outweighing sell positions, buoying the key Nikkei 225 average.
At 0015 GMT, it was up 183.08 points or 0.90 percent at 20,627.01. Its December futures were up 150 points at 20,660.
"Regarding the settlement, net buying amounted to about 200,000 shares, lifting the market," a broker at a "Big Four" brokerage said.
